text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The Milers Cup is 1,600 meters long! It's the same distance as the Oka Sho, but I want to do even better than I did back then.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If I do, maybe I can show Trainer an even brighter future!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr is laser-focused on the race, but I'm really fired up too!
